name: hud_ui_save_load_insert_entry_sorted_prefix
description: HudUiSaveLoadDialog::InsertEntryIntoSortedPrefix inserts a save/load entry into an already sorted newer-first prefix.
known_limits: Local VC5 COFF target hud_ui_save_load_sort_helpers passes for 0x436530 with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x436530 validates fastcall entryPosition in ECX, a 0x140-byte HudUiSaveLoadEntry by-value stack argument, backward shifts while entry.IsNewerThan(previous), and final 0x140-byte entry copy into the insertion position.
The native smoke verifies insertion of a middle timestamp into a newer-first prefix shifts the older entry and insertion of an oldest timestamp leaves the prefix order intact.
